file: 338 The Scariest Free Game Was Made by a Studio That Didnt Exist Part 1.mp4

lines.t: In 2014, a free horror game appeared on PlayStation. From a studio nobody had ever heard of.

full.credit: Clips: P.T. gameplay - Shirrako; Outstar; SVG (YouTube)

lines.t: It was called P.T. You walk down one hallway. Over and over. And every loop, something changes.

full.credit: Clips: P.T. gameplay - Shirrako; Outstar; SVG (YouTube)

lines.t: A radio talks about a family murder. A voice keeps repeating the same numbers.

full.credit: Clips: P.T. gameplay - Shirrako; Outstar; SVG (YouTube)

lines.t: And a ghost named Lisa follows you. If she catches you, you start over.

full.credit: Clips: P.T. gameplay - Shirrako; Outstar; SVG (YouTube)

lines.t: The studio was called 7780s Studio. It didn't exist.

full.credit: Clips: P.T. gameplay - Shirrako; Outstar; SVG (YouTube)

lines.t: When players finally solved the last puzzle, they found out who really made it. It was
